parsed.reason: With live unavailable, the right move is to say plainly it can't check, and the answer does that without stating any result, so the facts are fine. The tone is a bit stiff and apologetic ('Sorry I can't confirm it this time', 'I don't want to guess and give you a wrong score'), less like a quick casual text, but it doesn't read as a service offer and doesn't deflect to an app.
